name: Honda CB400 Super Four
engine: 399 cc liquid-cooled inline four with HYPER VTEC, carbs then fuel injection
intro: Japan's long-running learner and commuter four. Carbs on early bikes, fuel injection later, and VTEC that switches to four valves at high rpm.
recallNote: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before you start. Recalls on these models change over time.
